summary.en: Named cursors arrive on a shared board and keep drifting; one writes the brief title at its insertion point, the card turns ready and the others gather round.
summary.zh: 几枚具名光标先后飞进共享白板并持续漂移；一枚在插入点上写出简报标题，卡片变为就绪，其余人围拢过来。

fits: Showing a team working together in a shared space: named cursors on one board, one of them writing, the rest gathering round.
notFor: A single user's action (use a plain cursor-glide); more than five people; quiet passages (it is busy by design).

intent.en: Make the team's presence felt: named cursors arriving and drifting give the board the warmth of people in the room, and one of them typing the brief turns presence into work done together.
intent.zh: 让人感到团队在场：具名光标飞入、漂移，给白板铺上“有人在”的体温；其中一枚写出简报标题，把在场变成一起干活。

content.en: 3–5 one-word names (en ≤ 8 chars, zh ≤ 3), a title the last person types (en ≤ 32, zh ≤ 14), a board name, up to 6 notes (title en ≤ 22 / zh ≤ 8, meta en ≤ 12 / zh ≤ 5), two status words and an optional footer and share key.
content.zh: 3–5 个一词名字（英文 ≤ 8 字符，中文 ≤ 3 字），最后一人打出的标题（英文 ≤ 32，中文 ≤ 14），白板名，最多 6 张便签（标题英文 ≤ 22 / 中文 ≤ 8，元信息英文 ≤ 12 / 中文 ≤ 5），前后两个状态词，可选页脚和共享按钮文字。

fits.zh: 表现一个团队在共享空间里一起干活：同一块白板上的具名光标，一人在写，其余人围过来。

notFor.zh: 单个用户的操作（用普通的 cursor-glide）；超过五个人；安静的段落（它天生就忙）。

pairs.note: one pointer then clicking through the product

en: Each person's tone is their identity; keep it the same all film.
Keep the drifting cursors out of the area being read; the crowd is atmosphere and must give way.
When the typed title changes, keep its pauses natural (longer at spaces) and re-check that the ready status lands after the last letter.
zh: 每个人的颜色就是身份；全片保持一致。
漂移的光标要避开正在读的区域；群演是氛围，要让戏。
换打字标题后保持自然的停顿（空格多停），并核对“就绪”在最后一个字之后才出现。
